Imports

Types

Spinny = object
  text*: string
  frames*: seq[string]
  interval*: int
SpinnyColor = enum
  cDefault, cBlack, cRed, cGreen, cYellow, cBlue, cMagenta, cCyan, cWhite, cGray
SpinnyManager = object
Owns the terminal. All active spinners share one manager so they can be rendered on separate lines, one above the other. 
SpinnyState = enum
  stIdle, stSpinning, stStopped, stSucceeded, stFailed, stWarned, stInformed
